svg.title: Capital Health Region — Building Partnerships for Better Health — Spring 2000 dark and white variant
svg.desc: Original native paths from the Spring 2000 Proposed Regional Services Plan Summary Report, PDF page 12, archived at https://web.archive.org/web/20000925063128id_/http://www.caphealth.org:80/RSPSummary.pdf. Complete emblem, outlined name and tagline. The orange textured page background is excluded. Original dark ink and white components are preserved, without recolouring, tracing or substitute fonts. This is a dated appearance, not an adoption-date claim.
